name: Meghauli Serai, A Taj Safari
summary: A high-end safari lodge run by Taj on the Rapti riverbank at Meghauli, facing Chitwan National Park. Rooms and villas look across the river to the grassland, and the lodge's own naturalists lead jeep drives, walks and canoe trips on the quieter western side of the park.
body: Meghauli Serai sits on the northern bank of the East Rapti in Meghauli, on the western side of the Chitwan valley. From the lodge you look straight across the river into the park, and in the dry season rhinos and deer are often seen on the far bank from the garden. The setting is quiet, away from the lodges and traffic of Sauraha.

As a Taj Safari property it runs its own wildlife programme, with naturalists who guide jeep drives, walks and river trips and explain the ecology of the floodplain. Meals are taken in the lodge, and the pace of the day follows the animals: early starts, a long midday rest and drives again in the afternoon. It suits travellers who want comfort, privacy and well-organised safaris.
why: River-facing setting directly opposite the park
Own naturalists and safari programme on the quieter western side
Comfortable, private base for couples and slower trips

faqs.a: Meghauli Serai is in Meghauli, on the western side of the Chitwan valley, on the northern bank of the East Rapti river facing Chitwan National Park. It is about 35 km from Bharatpur airport, roughly 1 hour by road, and about 1.5 hours from Sauraha. The lodge usually arranges transfers.

faqs.q: Are safaris included at Meghauli Serai?
faqs.a: The lodge runs its own wildlife activities with in-house naturalists, including jeep drives, walks and river trips. Packages and what they include change by season, and national park fees may be charged separately. Confirm inclusions when you book, and check current status before you travel.

faqs.q: Is Meghauli Serai good for a honeymoon?
faqs.a: Yes. Its quiet riverside setting, comfortable rooms, good food and private safari programme make it one of the most popular choices for couples in Chitwan. Pair two or three nights here with Pokhara or Kathmandu for a relaxed honeymoon itinerary.

name: Barahi Jungle Lodge
summary: A comfortable riverside lodge at Meghauli on the edge of Chitwan National Park, with its own naturalists, jeep safaris, canoe trips and village visits. A calm alternative to Sauraha with good access to the park's western grasslands and the Narayani.
body: Barahi Jungle Lodge stands on the banks of the East Rapti at Meghauli, with the national park across the river. Rooms are set in gardens with views toward the forest, and the lodge has a restaurant and bar where guests gather after the evening drive. The village of Meghauli is a short walk away.

The lodge's safari team runs jeep drives into the western grasslands, canoe trips on the Rapti, guided walks with licensed nature guides and visits to Tharu homes and the Narayani confluence. It is a good choice for travellers who want a full programme of activities in a quieter part of Chitwan without going to the very top end of prices.
why: Riverside location opposite the park in quiet Meghauli
Full activity programme run by the lodge's own team
Easy access to the Narayani for gharials and sunsets

faqs.a: Barahi Jungle Lodge is in Meghauli, on the western side of Chitwan, on the bank of the East Rapti river opposite Chitwan National Park. It is about 1 hour by road from Bharatpur airport and about 1.5 hours from Sauraha. Transfers can be arranged by the lodge.

faqs.q: What activities does Barahi Jungle Lodge offer?
faqs.a: The lodge offers jeep safaris, canoe trips on the Rapti, guided jungle walks with licensed guides, birdwatching, Tharu village visits and sunset trips to the river. Park entry fees apply to activities inside Chitwan National Park. Ask the lodge for its current programme.

faqs.q: Is Barahi Jungle Lodge good for families?
faqs.a: Yes. The lodge is calm and spacious, and children usually enjoy canoe trips, jeep safaris and village visits. Walks inside the park often have minimum age rules. Ask the lodge about family rooms and child-friendly activities when booking.

name: Tiger Tops Tharu Lodge
summary: A lodge on the edge of Amaltari village in Nawalpur, built in the style of Tharu longhouses with mud-plastered walls, on the western side of Chitwan National Park. Its naturalists lead drives, walks and river trips, and the Tharu village is right outside the gate.
body: Tiger Tops is one of the oldest names in Nepal's wildlife tourism, and its Tharu Lodge sits beside Amaltari on the western edge of Chitwan National Park, in Nawalpur district. The buildings take their form from the Tharu longhouse, with long, low wings and mud-plastered walls, set among rice fields and gardens.

Naturalists lead jeep drives into the western sector of the park, guided walks, river trips on the Narayani and visits to the village, where Tharu and Bote families live and farm. The lodge is a good choice for travellers who want comfort, expert guiding and a strong connection with village life. It usually closes for part of the monsoon; check dates when booking.
why: Tharu longhouse-style architecture beside a working village
Experienced naturalists on the quiet western side of the park
Narayani river trips with a chance of wild gharials

faqs.q: Where is Tiger Tops Tharu Lodge?
faqs.a: Tiger Tops Tharu Lodge is beside Amaltari village in Kawasoti Municipality, Nawalpur district, on the western side of Chitwan National Park. It is about 7 km south of Kawasoti on the East-West Highway and roughly 1.5 hours by road from Bharatpur airport. The lodge arranges transfers.

faqs.q: Is Tiger Tops Tharu Lodge open all year?
faqs.a: The lodge usually closes for part of the monsoon, roughly mid-summer, when heavy rain limits park access. Opening dates change from year to year, so check current status before you travel and book early for the peak months of February to April.

faqs.q: What makes Tiger Tops Tharu Lodge different?
faqs.a: It is built in the style of a Tharu longhouse beside a real Tharu village, on the quieter western side of Chitwan, with experienced naturalists. Guests combine park drives and Narayani river trips with time in Amaltari village, which gives a fuller picture of life around the park.

name: Kasara Resort
summary: A villa resort at Patihani on the edge of Chitwan National Park, close to the park headquarters at Kasara. It has a pool, spa and restaurant, and arranges jeep drives into the central part of the park, visits to the gharial breeding centre and village bike rides.
body: Kasara Resort lies at Patihani, in the buffer zone across the Rapti from the park headquarters at Kasara, about 40 minutes by road from Bharatpur airport. Accommodation is in villas set in gardens, and the resort has a pool, a spa and a restaurant. It feels more like a retreat than a safari camp.

From here you are well placed for the central part of the park, which sees fewer jeeps than the Sauraha side, and for the gharial breeding centre. The resort arranges jeep safaris with licensed guides, birding along the Rapti and bike rides through the farm villages of Patihani. It suits couples and families who want comfort and a slower pace between activities.
why: Close to the park headquarters and gharial breeding centre
Pool, spa and villas for a slower, more comfortable stay
Quieter central park access than Sauraha

faqs.a: Kasara Resort is at Patihani, in the buffer zone of Chitwan National Park near the park headquarters at Kasara. It is about 40 minutes by road from Bharatpur airport and about 1 to 1.5 hours from Sauraha. The resort can arrange airport and bus transfers.

Yes. The resort arranges jeep safaris with licensed nature guides into the central part of Chitwan National Park, visits to the gharial breeding centre, birding along the Rapti and village bike rides. Park entry fees apply to activities inside the park.

faqs.q: Is Kasara Resort good for a relaxing stay?
faqs.a: Yes. With villas, a pool and a spa, it suits travellers who want to rest between safaris, honeymooners and families. It is quieter than Sauraha, with fewer shops and cafes nearby, so most guests eat at the resort.

name: Green Park Chitwan
image_query: Green Park Chitwan Sauraha hotel pool
summary: A well-run, comfortable hotel in Sauraha, a short walk from the Rapti and the park entrance, with an outdoor pool, gardens and a restaurant. A practical base for first-timers and families who want easy access to canoe trips, jeep safaris and the village.
body: Green Park Chitwan is in Sauraha, a few minutes' walk from the Rapti riverbank where canoe trips leave and sunset gathers a crowd. Rooms are air-conditioned with balconies, set around gardens and an outdoor pool that is welcome on hot spring afternoons. The restaurant serves Nepali and international food.

The hotel organises the full range of Chitwan activities through licensed guides: canoe trips on the Rapti, jeep safaris, jungle walks, Tharu village visits and the evening stick dance. Being in Sauraha, you have cafes, shops and the cultural hall within walking distance, which suits families and travellers who like some life in the evenings.
why: Walking distance to the Rapti, park entrance and cafes
Air-conditioned rooms and an outdoor pool for hot months
Full activity programme arranged by the hotel

faqs.a: Green Park Chitwan is in Sauraha, Ratnanagar Municipality, a short walk from the East Rapti riverbank and the entry points to Chitwan National Park. It is about 30 minutes by road from Bharatpur airport and close to the Sauraha tourist bus park.

faqs.q: Does Green Park Chitwan have a swimming pool?
faqs.a: Yes, the hotel has an outdoor pool, which is especially welcome from March to May when afternoon temperatures pass 30 °C. Pool hours and seasonal maintenance may vary, so check with the hotel before you travel if it matters to you.

faqs.q: Is Green Park Chitwan good for families?
faqs.a: Yes. The hotel is comfortable, has a pool and garden, and is within walking distance of the river, cafes and the cultural hall. It arranges family-friendly activities such as canoe trips, jeep safaris and Tharu village visits. Jungle walks may have age limits.
